name: WDUi Framework SDK
changes_cs: Aktualizovany WDUi Framework SDK: dlouhe SelectableTextBlock word-wrap texty uz nepremeruji prefix widths pro kazdy vizualni radek. Layout meri prefix widths jednou na odstavec, odvozuje z nich zalomene radky a pridava diagnostiku textPrefixMeasureCount pro dalsi vykonove kontroly.
changes_en: Updated WDUi Framework SDK: long SelectableTextBlock word-wrapped text no longer remeasures prefix widths for every visual line. Layout measures prefix widths once per paragraph, derives wrapped lines from that table, and adds textPrefixMeasureCount diagnostics for future performance checks.
